## Deviations from Design

None. Slice 4 implementation is faithful to design.md:
- Coverage detection uses keyword heuristic (slugs + H1 titles) as designed
- Assessment is always user-confirmed before any drafts are skipped
- Covered topics consume no NNNN slot; NO-SIGNAL within scope still consumes its slot
- Full-coverage clean exit uses exact wording from tasks.md: "All starter ADR topics are already covered. No drafts needed."
- Fresh consumer (no ADRs) skips coverage step entirely — proceeds directly to Phase 1 with all 3 topics

## Known edge case (documented, user-confirmed design)
- `language` keyword in Stack topic set can produce false positives: e.g. `adr-0009-documentation-language-policy.md` matches "language" even though it is about docs language, not programming language. Design says "keyword heuristic + user-confirmed" — the user can override via `include stack` if the match is incorrect. No code change needed.
